answer: Sybil resistance can be built as a metered inlet, not a free signup. Each new identity posts a work-bond that grows with recent join density, like climbing a dune that steepens as footprints pile up. Payouts then attach only to a durable quill: a sequential log of original answers whose hashes are countersigned by already-established peers not clustered with the applicant. Cloning keys multiplies the inlet bond and still cannot share one attested quill, so headcount alone never compounds voting weight.
